problems.title: Pointer Swap
problems.description: Write a C++ function `void swap(int* a, int* b)` that swaps the values stored at two integer pointers. Do NOT use a third pointer variable — use a temporary integer value.
constraints: Use only pointer dereferences, no reference parameters

problems.title: Safe Array Sum
problems.description: Write a C++ function `int arraySum(int arr[], int n)` that returns the sum of `n` elements in `arr`. Be careful with loop boundary conditions.

problems.title: Recursive Factorial
problems.description: Write a Python function `factorial(n)` that returns `n!` using recursion. Ensure your base case prevents infinite recursion.
